title: An ibuprofen-eluting electrospun membrane prevents ureteral fibrosis by dampening macrophage-associated fibroblast activation.
snippet: Ureteral stricture is driven by unresolved inflammation and progressive matrix deposition, yet mechanism-guided local therapies remain limited. We integrated spatial transcriptomics of human normal and stricture ureters with an in-house scRNA-seq reference generated from three stricture specimens and independently evaluated annotation using the normal urete...
